briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push frontier capabilities amid escalating compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple advanced models this month as global AI investment hit record quarterly levels. Competition between US and Chinese labs intensified with new multimodal capabilities and agentic systems. Safety concerns mount as deployment outpaces governance frameworks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with advanced reasoning benchmarks exceeding prior versions while Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind launched Gemini 3 and Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B. xAI and DeepSeek announced competing agent frameworks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA shipped record H200 volumes while Microsoft and Google expanded data center capacity in Texas and Arizona. TSMC accelerated 2nm production dedicated to AI accelerators amid ongoing power grid constraints.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory frameworks in the US and EU meaningfully constrain frontier model deployment before 2028?
